name: ID, AML and regulatory checks and audits
summary: Reads the ID, AML and regulatory check state of each client matter in the business's verification platform, records what is open or still waiting, and queues a case note for a compliance person to approve. Crons read and queue only; a person decides every check result and every change to a case.

aml-matter-onboarding.evidence: 6 of the 43 worklist calls were read; 5 describe this way of working (accounting practices, law firms, a real estate agency)

covered_by.client-intake: gap (case creation is mapped but no cron starts a case; the matter system is not mapped)
covered_by.beneficial-owner-check: gap (the platform docs do not describe it)
covered_by.aml-screening: case-watch and open-items (open and waiting screening states)
covered_by.risk-assessment: gap (the platform makes no rating; the business does)
covered_by.approval: gap (staff set check status in the platform)
covered_by.remediation: gap (proof collection is a person's job)
covered_by.ongoing-monitoring: gap (the docs do not say clients are re-checked on a schedule)
covered_by.regulatory-report: gap (the platform does not lodge reports)

crons.name: case-watch
crons.summary: Read cases updated since the last run and record each person's and entity's check state.

crons.name: open-items
crons.summary: Queue one case note for each set of open screening or verification items, for a compliance person to approve.

draft_ops_note: Read operations only. Nothing a cron drafts is written to the platform. A case note is an internal record, but it sits in a regulated file, so it is queued for a person rather than drafted.

first-aml.covers: case search and paging, case check state for people and entities, case notes (queued)

gaps: Smokeball, the matter system where owners key intake by hand: the platform evidence did not cover it, so no adapter. Intake from it is not built.

Beneficial owner identification, licence checks, enhanced due diligence, second-reviewer approval, audit sampling and AUSTRAC lodgement: the First AML docs do not describe them, so they stay with the business.
Risk assessment: the platform gives check results only. The rating is a person's judgment and is not drafted by any cron.
Running verification checks and creating cases are mapped in the kit but not used by any cron, because each may contact a client or use a paid check.
Field names come from the vendor's sandbox schema. Case ID format, check status values in live data and the reading of the entity status fields are unconfirmed until a sandbox account runs them.
The adapter is docs-only: nothing has run against a First AML account. The FIRST_AML_ACCESS_TOKEN sign-in is not built yet (the platform file says so).

evidence.calls: 6 of 43 worklist calls read, none rejected; the rest are not in the evidence file
evidence.platforms: First AML vendor docs, mapped step by step (client intake, identity, screening, approval, record-keeping, monitoring, remediation); Smokeball has no platform evidence
